headline: Executive order changes federal rules on scientific research that uses human stem cells.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order removes certain limits the federal government had placed on scientific research involving human stem cells. It directs that such research be done responsibly. No official summary was provided, so details such as specific funding rules or deadlines are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Scientists and research institutions that study human stem cells
who_it_affects.how: They may face fewer federal barriers when doing human stem cell research.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that fund or oversee medical research
who_it_affects.how: They may need to change how they handle human stem cell research under the new policy.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 9, 2009; no separate effective date was provided in the source material.
